title: Friendship Chests
intro: Friendship Chests are pink chests awarded for collecting friend points with other players. For every 10 friend points you accumulate, you receive one Friendship Chest. You can hold a maximum of 5 Friendship Chests at one time.
earning_body: Friend points are earned by visiting other players' zoos and having them visit yours. Once you reach 10 friend points, a Friendship Chest is automatically added to your inventory. The chest limit of 5 means you should open chests regularly to keep earning new ones.
contents_body: Friendship Chests contain exclusively enclosure puzzle pieces — they do not contain ready-to-place decorations. This includes puzzle pieces for enclosure decorations and utility buildings across all biomes. Since February 17, 2022, Friendship Chests also contain pieces for the exclusive Friendship Animals, which cannot be obtained from any other chest type.

enclosures_body: Friendship Chests contain puzzle pieces for enclosure decorations and utility buildings. These pieces are spread across all biomes and include both decorative and functional enclosure items.
tips_body: Open your Friendship Chests regularly so you do not hit the 5-chest cap and stop earning new ones. The most efficient way to earn friend points is to have an active friends list and visit zoos daily. Friendship Animals are exclusive to this chest type, making it the only source for completing their collections.
